items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: We used to play with Hal Galper. He’d stop the band and he’d get on the microphone and say, “I can hear you, can you hear me?”

ctx.x: Okay. I guess what I’m after is you know noisy nightclub.

Oh yeah. I don’t even pay attention to them. My attitude is you don’t bother me, I don’t bother you. Some people get really annoyed. We used to play with Hal Galper. He’d stop the band and he’d get on the microphone and say, “I can hear you, can you hear me?” And I get that. That’s his way to do it. For me I’d just concentrate more on the music. If these people are spending money to come, if they want to talk go ahead. It’s just personally as long as — I hope it’s not too loud but even if it is probably you start…
Of course the people that are complaining have sat right down in front of the band.
